Commentary challenges and extraction workflow

A · Parsing and understanding semi-structured data

Broad full-page parsing with task-specific layout, text, table and formula annotations.

Workflow steps: Prepare and read source documents, Bind values to the correct unit

Mapping basis and transfer limits

Parsing score is not systematic-review extraction accuracy.

These links describe the task content. They do not establish successful transfer to psychological evidence synthesis or validate a complete workflow.

Published results

Each figure uses a chart-specific date range covering all eligible documented model releases in that condition, with a small margin. The vertical axis retains the original performance metric. Calendar ranges can differ; compare the date labels, not the visual steepness of lines across figures. Values without an established release date remain in the data table. The APA reference for the selected benchmark version is shown directly below each figure. Model release-date sources are collected on a separate page.
